Opcjonalny. Daty z lat 2010–2026 są w pr: Optional. Dates for 2010–2026 ship with the app, the key refreshes upcoming dates once a day. You can get a free key at fred.stlouisfed.org. It goes only to the .env file on this computer, not to Notion or sync.
Opcjonalny. Historia działa bez klucza,: Optional. History works without a key, new earnings dates need one. You can get a free key at finnhub.io. It goes only to the .env file on this computer, not to Notion or sync.
Wyniki spółek z S&P 100 jako romb w chwi: S&P 100 earnings as a diamond at the announcement time: BMO before 9:30, AMC after 16:00 New York time. Without a time they show as a day label. Off by default.
Dziś po zamknięciu, jutro przed otwarcie: Today after the close, tomorrow before the open and the next class 1 results. If you do not set it, it appears once you add a Finnhub key.
Luki wypełnia kalendarz Finnhub, ale dop: The Finnhub calendar fills the gaps, but only from the install date. We cannot recover older results of these companies.
Przenosi spółkę z S&P 100 do wybranej kl: Moves an S&P 100 company to the chosen class or adds your own. Dates for a new company come only from Finnhub.

Wyniki spółek z S&P 100: romb w chwili o: S&P 100 earnings: a diamond at the announcement time (before the open, after the close); a day label when the time is unknown.
Klucz zapisany. Dane pobierają się w tle: Key saved. Data downloads in the background, the status appears below.

To dopiero {n} z {min} trade'ów. Poniżej: That is only {n} of {min} trades. Below {min} a result is easily chance: treat the numbers as a sketch, not a conclusion.
wygrane z rozstrzygniętych, BE poza licz: wins out of decided trades, BE not counted
suma R wszystkich trade'ów: sum of R over all trades
Narastający wynik trade po trade'cie w j: Running result trade by trade in units of risk. Rising = profit, falling = drawdown.
Żaden wiersz nie ma jeszcze {min} trade': No row has {min} trades yet. The numbers show what happened but give no basis for saying which row is better. Collect more days.
Tylko jeden wiersz ma co najmniej {min}: Only one row has at least {min} trades, so there is nothing to compare it with. The rest is too little data.
Wśród wierszy z co najmniej {min} trade': Among rows with at least {min} trades: the best is {best} ({bavg} per trade, n = {bn}), the weakest is {worst} ({wavg} per trade, n = {wn}).
Trade liczy się w każdym typie dnia, któ: A trade counts in every day type that describes its day (e.g. CPI and OPEX at once), so the rows can add up to more than the number of trades.
Cechy dni są niedostępne, więc typ dnia: Day features are unavailable, so the day type is empty.
Wiersze z mniej niż {min} trade'ami są p: Rows with fewer than {min} trades are dimmed: that is too little to talk about an edge.
Mniej niż {min} trade'ów z MAE i MFE: śr: Fewer than {min} trades with MAE and MFE: the averages can change a lot.
o tyle średnio cena szła pod prąd, zanim: how far price went against you on average before the trade ended
o tyle średnio cena szła w dobrą stronę: how far price went your way on average
strat z rzędu; BE przerywa serię: losses in a row; a BE breaks the streak
Jak głęboko szła cena pod prąd w wygrany: How deep price went against you in winning trades (MAE)
